audience: sales and support teams that work in Vtiger CRM on Vtiger Cloud

useCases.title: Review leads by rating or owner
useCases.text: The AI reads the module's fields and picklist values, then lists and counts leads filtered by fields such as rating, source or owner.

useCases.title: Find a customer by email or phone
useCases.text: The AI finds contacts, leads or organizations by an exact email address or phone number and opens the full record.

useCases.title: Report on open deals and cases
useCases.text: The AI checks the module's fields, then runs read-only SELECT queries on it, for example deals by stage or open cases of an organization, up to 100 records per call.

useCases.title: Add a lead and tag it
useCases.text: The AI checks the mandatory fields, creates the lead assigned to you, and tags it, for example with the name of an event.

useCases.title: Update records after a call
useCases.text: The AI opens the record, then changes only the fields you name, such as a deal's stage or a case's status, and leaves the rest as it is. Nothing is deleted.
